probes.prompt:
/playground:playground Build a small self-contained profile-card design playground, using the skill's design-playground template. This is a headless file-generation task: save card-playground.html and state that browser opening/visual review remains for the caller; do not launch a browser or pretend you did. Give it title Profile card playground. Inline all CSS and one classic JavaScript script, use a dark theme, viewport meta, system fonts, a controls column, a live profile-card preview, and a natural-language prompt output with clipboard copy and brief Copied! feedback.
Use exactly three controls with ids radius,padding,shadow: radius range 0–24 px, padding range 8–40 px, and a shadow checkbox. Preview id preview, prompt id prompt, copy-button id copy. Provide three named presets Balanced (radius12,padding20,shadowfalse), Compact (4,12,false), Soft (20,28,true). Use a single state object. Every control input and preset click immediately calls updateAll; no Apply button.
Keep a top-level const PRESETS with those three keys and values, const DEFAULTS equal to Balanced, and function cardModel(state). This pure business function returns {style:{borderRadius:<radius>+"px",padding:<padding>+"px",boxShadow:"none" when false or a real CSS shadow when true},prompt:<natural language instruction about the profile card>}. Mention only nondefault settings in the prompt; nondefault radius/padding include their px value; mention shadow when enabled. Default prompt need not repeat 12px or 20px. updateAll must call cardModel(state), apply its style to the actual preview and its prompt to the actual prompt output. Wrap document/DOM initialization in if (typeof document !== "undefined") so the same actual script's pure function can also execute in Node without any DOM mock. Do not substitute a fake DOM or implement a second verification-only function.
Keep the whole page under 180 lines and avoid decorative filler. Read verify_playground.mjs and run exactly node verify_playground.mjs through Bash after writing the page. This is the only allowed shell command, with no prefix,suffix,redirection or extra operation. The immutable verifier checks real JavaScript business outputs and static HTML bindings; it does not prove browser pixels or clipboard permission behavior. Never modify the verifier or use model file tools to read/write playground-verification.json; the verifier owns it. No dependencies, accounts, network, packages or other CLI calls.
